history: Only records strictly earlier than the predicted night; last up to 3 nonmissing values per measure.
sleep_interval: Elapsed minutes from sleep onset to final waking, including nocturnal awakenings.
preprocessing: SimpleImputer(median, keep_empty_features=True) then StandardScaler, fitted on eligible training records only.
storage: Each final joblib contains feature order, fitted preprocessing pipeline and weights for all 3 seeds.
